featured_reviews.review_text:
"Overall Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5 out of 5 stars)
Date of Service: 20 July 2025
Full tune-up and spoke replacement on my front wheel.
After hitting a pothole and bending a spoke. From the moment I contacted Gear Grow Cycle the staff, especially Akash was incredibly friendly and professional. As it is a doorstep service, everything was transparent and see through. He quickly reachd the location where I was down with my bike& assessed the damage and recommended a full tune-up as well, explaining everything clearly. I received a transparent quote via email and in front within minutes. They assembled everything in front of me and there was no doubt of excellent work bike was ready, which was earlier than expected!
When I took for trial , my bike felt brand new. The shifting is incredibly smooth, the brakes are perfectly adjusted, and the new spoke blends seamlessly. Akash walked me through all the work they did and gave me some great tips for chain maintenance. The price was very reasonable for the quality of work.
Excellent communication, speedy service, highly skilled mechanics, fair pricing.
Would I recommend? Definitely!
I'm so impressed with Gear Grow Cycle. They not only fixed my immediate problem but also made my bike ride better than it has in years. Fantastic service all around. I'll be coming back for all my future bike needs!

featured_reviews.name: Diksha Wakde
featured_reviews.review_text: Very Happy with service. Very well managed. My bicycle was ready within half an hour. Keep up with the best service. I will always prefer to book my servicing appointment from Gear Grow Cycle. 👍🏻

featured_reviews.name: sarthak karande
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)
I recently used 'GEAR GROW CYCLE' doorstep bicycle service  and had a fantastic experience! The mechanic arrived right at my doorstep, fully equipped and on time. My cycle had issues with the brakes and gear shifter, and they were fixed quickly and professionally.

The service was affordable, transparent, and very convenient—no need to take the bike to a shop! The mechanic was friendly, explained what needed to be done, and even gave tips for maintenance.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for reliable cycle repair at home. Will definitely use their service again!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently bought a new bike, Trinx M500 Pro from this place and I would say that the place is pretty good if you know what you want to buy. But the attitude of the sales people over here is not customer friendly. I mean I literally had to ask multiple times about the product to get some words out of their mouth. The owner was just busy with his mobile phone and hardly bothered about the customers. I think the products they offer are good but they need to be a lot customer centric and approachable but I guess they have a lot of money to even bother.

Anyways, the bike is awesome and they have really good range of high end imported bicycles if you have the knowledge and do not need any support form the sales staff.

Great team! Amazing service
